# Keep keyboard focus in the form after reopening a draft

## What & Why
Keyboard recovery is now covered for timing and view changes, but the interaction is not complete unless focus lands in the reopened form. A focus regression would force keyboard users to search for where to continue editing.

## Done looks like
- Enter and Space recovery both reopen the correct answer or opportunity form.
- Focus lands on the first meaningful field in the reopened form.
- The existing recovery announcements remain intact.
